text:
Maya (Partnerships): Heads-up 1: CedarForge wants to list Cedar-6B on our cloud marketplace and do a co-sell with NimbusSI + EdgeLayer. They shipped under a "Cedar Public Research License (CPRL)". Need to decide hosting vs download terms.
Diego (Legal): CPRL looks research-biased. Maya, can you paste the redistribution clause? I'll run the license-bot check.
Maya (Partnerships): pasted clause: 
```
Redistribution: Model weights may be used for academic and internal research. Commercial redistribution or rehosting requires explicit written consent from CedarForge. Attribution required for hosted offerings.
```
Sara (Product): Impact: Dedicated customers sometimes expect download for on-prem deployments. If CPRL forbids redistribution, Private/Dedicated download will be blocked unless we negotiate a commercial redistribution grant. Also need quantized artifacts for runtime.
Priya - NimbusSI: NimbusSI needs to bake quantized weights into our deployment images. We need a redistrib grant at least covering Redwood + NimbusSI distribution to named customers, ideally a blanket partner sublicense to avoid per-deal friction.
Owen - EdgeLayer: For hardware certification, EdgeLayer needs a QA bundle (weights + test vectors) under NDA. We can't accept per-customer approvals; need a certification channel that lets us test and sign off.
Diego (Legal): Two legal paths: (1) Partner sublicense addendum that grants Redwood+SI rights for distribution to paying customers; (2) Per-customer addenda. Path (1) preferred for scale, but CedarForge may prefer per-customer controls. I'll draft both.
license-bot: license-compare started: CPRL vs MIT/Apache -> conflict recorded: redistribution restricted. Recommend ask for explicit redistribution clause or carveouts for certified partners.
Maya (Partnerships): Marketing ask: CedarForge wants a co-branded launch + "Host-only" SKU plus an "Enterprise (download + SI)" SKU if we can secure redistribute rights. They want press on listing date too. Timeline: target 5-7 weeks.
Sara (Product): Perf/dev notes: Product needs 2 weeks for baseline perf, 1 week for quantization/compat builds. We need sample weights to start. Also: target Dedicated SLO: 60ms p99 on 8k.
Priya - NimbusSI: If per-customer addenda is needed, we require a short redistribution appendix template that legal can sign quickly. NimbusSI can accept per-deal approach if template exists.
Owen - EdgeLayer: Certification-only delivery is fine with NDA and a limited use license. We'll need quant formats: int8 and fp16, and a canonical scoring script.
Diego (Legal): Draft checklist for redline: 
- Partner sublicense for Redwood + named SI, rights to package/distribute to paying customers.
- Certification/NDA channel for hardware partners with no redistribution.
- Attribution wording for hosted offering.
- Export controls & provenance attestation request from CedarForge.
I'll circulate redlines by EOD.
Maya (Partnerships): Action items: 
- Diego to send two redline options (partner sublicense vs per-customer appendix).
- Maya to ask CedarForge for provenance docs, preferred addendum, and marketing assets.
- Priya & Owen to upload their QA matrix and quant requirements.
- Sara to schedule perf runs wk of 3762050000.
license-bot: export-check: no immediate red flags; provenance verification recommended if model includes third-party datasets.
Diego (Legal): Note: If we accept a partner sublicense, include a clause limiting sublicenses to Redwood and named SI partners only, and require CedarForge consent for additional partners. Also include indemnity caps and audit rights.
Maya (Partnerships): CedarForge requested we avoid "download" language publicly for the Host-only SKU. Fine. If we can secure the partner addendum, we'll offer an "Enterprise download+SI" tier visible in sales docs only.
Priya - NimbusSI: We'll prepare a one-page SOW + redistribution appendix template for legal to use.
Owen - EdgeLayer: Dropping test vectors and quant notes into shared drive now.
Sara (Product): Hold tentative embargo dates: A) partner addendum secured -> launch in 5 weeks. B) per-customer rollout -> staged starting 7-9 weeks.
Maya (Partnerships): Great. I'll ping CedarForge and update this thread. :raised_hands:
